recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source change is recommended for FHIR-37773; revisit only through a new ConceptMap terminology decision if the work group wants more explicit version guidance for valueCode.
issue_request: FHIR-37773 was Published/Not Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to remove code as a choice for ConceptMap2 dependsOn/product value[x] because valueCode did not identify a code system or version; the final decision kept valueCode and requested clarifying text that interpretation depends on the associated property and that valueCode implies a known code system.
initial_application: Git commit b77b742253cb7f301ec7dc2eb3c42199e3ef331c initially applied FHIR-37773 by adding explanatory text to source/conceptmap/conceptmap-notes.xml and changing the $translate output sentence to mention only dependsOn values. Git commit 5ecdbc1543dd35ac497b27908244b08949fd467a later broadened the section to target.dependsOn and target.product and restored product in that output sentence.
additional_context: ConceptMap is an active resource in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-32541 established that both dependsOn and product values are included in $translate output, which current source/conceptmap/operationdefinition-ConceptMap-translate.xml implements with both match.product and match.dependsOn output parts. FHIR-40504 later split mapping properties from additional attributes, and FHIR-40636 later clarified that dependsOn.valueCode uses the group source code system and product.valueCode uses the group target code system.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current notes and StructureDefinition already convey the needed valueCode guidance using the later source/target rule, and removing product from the $translate sentence would now conflict with the active OperationDefinition and later ConceptMap decisions.
